titulo: Go for a walk without a podcast
caption:
Go for a walk without a podcast

Go for a walk. No podcast. No "optimizing." Just look at things.

You can learn nothing for twenty minutes and survive. Take someone with you.

#Cella #walk

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pink room with a floor line and no furniture. Two small block figures with white eyes, one ink-black and one royal blue, walk side by side toward the right, in no hurry. They stop and look up at something with wide eyes, then keep walking and both smile. At the end the ink-black one looks at the camera with narrowed eyes. The text stays: if this found you: go for a walk. No podcast. No optimizing. Just walk.
